title: It's Much Easier for Neural Networks to learn Game of Life Dynamics with the Right Activation Function: Polynomial Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
abstract: arXiv:2606.23587v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Previous work has found a gap between the scale of neural networks that reliably learn Conway's Game of Life, and minimal networks capable of representing the classic cellular automaton with hard-coded parameter values. Viewing neural network learning as a search process suggests a dependence on networks large enough to contain sub-networks with lucky initializations (sometimes known as 'winning tickets') that actually learn the task. In this work, we reorient our perspective from discovering Life rules as a search problem back to a learning problem, and reason that with fitting inductive biases, the problem should be much more amenable to minimal networks. translated_title: 使用正确的激活函数：多项式Kolmogorov-Arnold网络，神经网络学习生命游戏动态变得容易得多
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.23587v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：先前研究发现，可靠学习康威生命游戏的神经网络规模与能够用硬编码参数值表示经典元胞自动机的最小网络之间存在差距。将神经网络学习视为搜索过程表明，其依赖于足够大的网络，以包含具有幸运初始化（有时称为“中奖彩票”）的子网络，这些子网络实际学习任务。在这项工作中，我们将视角从将发现生命规则视为搜索问题重新转向学习问题，并推断，通过合适的归纳偏置，该问题应更适用于最小网络。我们发现，具有几种替代激活函数的网络变体在性能上显著优于默认的整流线性单元，特别是，二阶多项式激活函数在有或无学习优势的情况下都能一致地学习生命动态。
tldr: 本文表明，使用二阶多项式激活函数（如多项式Kolmogorov-Arnold网络）能显著提高最小神经网络学习康威生命游戏动态的能力，优于默认的ReLU激活函数。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that using a second-degree polynomial activation function (as in Polynomial Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks) significantly improves minimal neural networks' ability to learn Conway's Game of Life dynamics, outperforming the default ReLU activation.
